requirement: identity/email explicit verification auto-signin with original remember policy

request.Confirmation: VerificationConfirmRequest: original delivered registration grant and callback
request.Device: trusted bounded current risk correlation, not identity authority
request.remember: absent: recover resolved policy from authenticated encrypted signup intent

result.Issuance: separate session-owned child outcome and reveal-once delivery
result.Recovery: exact child scope; metadata-only, never execution or disclosure authority
result.Challenge: optional explicitly selected pending TOTP continuation: ID, Method, original ExpiresAt and fresh-only opaque Proof; mutually exclusive with session/cookie/CSRF

transactions: original verification-confirm commits address 1 -> 2, one-use grant, audit and lifecycle
only its fresh successful invocation may attempt linked session 0 -> 1 with audit and lifecycle
unique tenant/confirmation parent prevents two child issuances
current directory, recipient, authorization and original factor generation are fenced before final commit
unknown/replayed verification creates no child; unknown/replayed child reveals no credential
authentication: email possession, not password comparison or a renewed signup proof
factor_profile: default known-empty authoritative MFA only; enrolled/unknown deny without fallback

enrolled_totp.selection: passwordpostgres.VerificationSigninConfig.TOTP plus independently composed verification-origin TOTP completion; reference PasswordSignup.VerificationTOTP
enrolled_totp.known_empty: unchanged direct session path; unavailable, corrupt or unsupported factor authority denies
enrolled_totp.challenge: separate committed child C after verification V; exact original signup browser, confirmation ID, tenant/user, policy/factor generations, remember and earliest original expiry
enrolled_totp.completion: identity.mfa.totp-verify F authenticates the genuine enrolled factor and protected original parent custody, then atomically commits replay/attempt state, child use, audit/lifecycle and one MFA email-possession session
enrolled_totp.provenance: email possession plus real TOTP, never manufactured password comparison or magic-link consumption
enrolled_totp.recovery: original V/C/F outcomes reconcile metadata only; no replacement proof, password, factor secret, session credential or renewed freshness
enrolled_totp.migrations: reference VerificationSessionLineage must permanently select VerificationBeforeMFA or MFABeforeVerification; preserve applied histories and add only native forward suffixes

http.cookies: original signup flow and signed browser-device cookie
http.response: parent confirmation plus optional child signin metadata; only fresh authenticated completion delivers secure HttpOnly cookie and X-CSRF-Token
http.pending_totp_selection: emailhttp.VerificationSigninConfig.MFAContinuation explicitly permits pending challenge delivery; no session/cookie/CSRF
http.pending_totp_proof: fresh original proof only in X-MFA-Token, never JSON/redirect/replay; expiry/cancellation/error withholds it without erasing committed verification
http.totp_completion: separately selected mfahttp.FeatureConfig.VerificationTOTPVerify or reference HTTPMFA.VerificationTOTPVerify; POST /v1/mfa/totp-verify always requires singleton X-MFA-Variant: verification and original signup flow/device custody; no absent-header or cross-primary fallback
http.defaults: verification-only; managed/address-change profiles acquire no login

acceptance: browser and persistent original remember choices through native and selected HTTPS
real registration, captured delivery, verification, signin, primary read and logout
wrong original browser and absent HTTP browser/device deny
policy, missing/nonempty factors, blocked account and unavailable risk deny
rollback of either transaction preserves the other observed outcome accurately
contending confirmations produce one verification and at most one child
lost actual commit acknowledgements at both boundaries withhold credentials and retain recovery
default and shared managed confirmation remain verification-only
genuine enrolled TOTP native/HTTPS browser and persistent choices: V -> pending C -> actual factor F -> authenticated read -> logout
pending C reveals no session/cookie/CSRF; wrong browser/variant/code deny and exhaustion revokes the shared budget without child use or session
late parent/account/identifier/policy/factor changes and original absolute expiry deny before protected completion
C/F rollback, same/distinct-command contention, real lost commit acknowledgements and interrupted durable preparation preserve atomic effects and metadata-only recovery

populated verification-first and MFA-first upgrades preserve native migration records, original issuance/session/operator custody and retained session reads; later password/magic-link composition stays forward-only and unmanaged suffixes deny
